repos.summary_en: Prompts.chat is the world's largest open-source prompt library for AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It offers a community-driven platform to share, discover, and collect prompts, with free public access and self-hosting options for organizations seeking privacy.

repos.description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
repos.summary_zh: Dify 是一个生产就绪的 AI 智能体工作流开发平台，支持可视化编排、多模型集成与自动化流程构建，适用于企业级应用开发与 AI 能力快速集成场景。
repos.summary_en: Dify is a production-ready platform for agentic workflow development, enabling visual orchestration, multi-model integration, and automated process building for enterprise AI application development.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: Langflow is a powerful tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows.
repos.summary_zh: Langflow 是一个强大的 AI 智能体与工作流构建平台，提供可视化拖拽界面和 Python 源码级定制能力。支持多智能体编排、API/MCP 部署、LangSmith 可观测性集成，内置主流 LLM 与向量数据库支持，适用于企业级 AI 应用快速开发与部署。
repos.summary_en: Langflow is a powerful platform for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows. It offers a visual builder interface, source code customization in Python, multi-agent orchestration, API/MCP deployment, LangSmith observability, and native support for major LLMs and vector databases, making it ideal for rapid enterprise-grade AI application development.

repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面一体化助手工具，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的统一管理，提供便捷的 AI 编程助手集成与配置，适用于多模型协作开发场景。
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform desktop all-in-one assistant tool for managing Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, enabling unified configuration and integration of multiple AI coding assistants for streamlined development workflows.

repos.description: The agent engineering platform.
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 是一个构建可靠 AI 智能体的框架，提供标准化的 LLM、嵌入、向量存储等组件接口，支持实时数据增强、模型互操作性和快速原型开发，助力开发者高效构建生产级 LLM 应用。
repos.summary_en: LangChain is a framework for building reliable AI agents and LLM-powered applications. It offers standardized interfaces for models, embeddings, and vector stores, enabling real-time data augmentation, model interoperability, and rapid prototyping for production-ready AI solutions.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了30,000+行关于主流AI编程工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Devin AI等）的系统提示、内部工具和模型架构的深度解析，涵盖其设计理念、功能实现与技术细节，为开发者提供全面的AI编程助手技术洞察与最佳实践参考。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains over 30,000 lines of insights into system prompts, internal tools, and AI models of major AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Devin AI), offering deep technical analysis of their architecture, functionality, and design principles for developers seeking to understand and leverage AI-powered development tools.

repos.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
repos.summary_zh: gstack 是 Garry Tan（YC 创始人）基于 Claude Code 构建的 AI 工程团队工具集，集成 CEO、设计师、工程师、发布经理等 15 个角色，通过 slash 命令实现产品规划、代码审查、QA 测试、安全审计和自动化部署。支持每日 1-2 万行代码的高效开发，适用于技术型创始人、Claude Code 新手及资深技术负责人。
repos.summary_en: gstack is Garry Tan's (YC President) AI-powered engineering toolkit built on Claude Code, featuring 15 specialized roles including CEO, designer, eng manager, and QA. It enables ultra-high productivity coding through slash commands for planning, review, testing, security audits, and deployment—ideal for technical founders, Claude Code beginners, and senior tech leads.

repos.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 是一款开源 AI 智能体，将 Gemini 的强大功能直接集成到终端中，提供对 Gemini 3 模型的轻量级访问，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令等内置工具，并具备 MCP 扩展能力，专为命令行开发者设计，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
repos.summary_en: Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal, offering lightweight access to Gemini 3 models with built-in tools like Google Search, file operations, and shell commands, plus extensibility via MCP (Model Context Protocol), designed for developers who live in the command line.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: Everything Claude Code 是一个专为 AI 智能体性能优化设计的完整系统，涵盖技能、直觉、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cowork 等平台，提供生产级代理、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置，适用于多语言环境，是 Anthropic 黑客马拉松获奖作品。
repos.summary_en: Everything Claude Code is a comprehensive performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, featuring skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, and more, offering production-ready agents, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configurations, evolved over 10+ months of real-world use.

repos.description: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
repos.summary_zh: RAGFlow 是一款领先的开放源代码检索增强生成（RAG）引擎，深度融合 RAG 与 Agent 能力，为大型语言模型构建卓越的上下文层。它提供简洁高效的 RAG 工作流，适用于各类规模企业，支持多语言文档处理、智能问答、知识库构建及 Agent 驱动任务自动化。
repos.summary_en: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that seamlessly integrates advanced RAG with Agent capabilities to build superior context layers for LLMs. It delivers a streamlined, scalable workflow ideal for enterprises, supporting multilingual document processing, intelligent Q&A, knowledge base construction, and agent-driven task automation.

repos.description: 🐹 Open-source Mac and PC cleaner. Keep your machine clean, light, and running like new. Fast CLI, plus native Mac and Windows apps.
repos.summary_zh: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

repos.description: 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型——完全免费，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.

repos.description: 为GPT/GLM等LLM大语言模型提供实用化交互接口，特别优化论文阅读/润色/写作体验，模块化设计，支持自定义快捷按钮&函数插件，支持Python和C++等项目剖析&自译解功能，PDF/LaTex论文翻译&总结功能，支持并行问询多种LLM模型，支持chatglm3等本地模型。接入通义千问, deepseekcoder, 讯飞星火, 文心一言, llama2, rwkv, claude2, moss等。
repos.summary_zh: GPT Academic 是为 GPT/GLM 等 LLM 大语言模型设计的实用化交互接口，专注论文阅读、润色与写作优化，支持模块化插件与自定义快捷按钮，集成 Python/C++ 项目剖析、PDF/LaTeX 论文翻译与总结功能，兼容通义千问、DeepSeek、文心一言等主流模型，支持本地部署与多模型并行调用。
repos.summary_en: GPT Academic is a practical interface for GPT/GLM and other LLMs, optimized for academic tasks like paper reading, editing, and writing. It features modular plugins, custom shortcuts, code analysis, PDF/LaTeX translation, and supports multiple models including Qwen, DeepSeek, and local deployments like ChatGLM3.

repos.description: ChatGPT 中文调教指南。各种场景使用指南。学习怎么让它听你的话。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供全面的 ChatGPT 中文调教指南，涵盖学术论文、创意写作、商业文案、翻译、数据分析等 20+ 应用场景，帮助用户掌握提示词技巧，让 AI 高效完成各类任务，提升工作效率与内容质量。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive guide to prompting ChatGPT in Chinese, covering over 20 use cases including academic writing, creative content, business communication, translation, and data analysis. It empowers users to master prompt engineering and leverage AI for enhanced productivity and content quality.

repos.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Pake 是一个基于 Rust Tauri 框架的网页转桌面应用工具，支持一键将任意网页打包为跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）原生应用。核心优势包括体积小巧（仅约5MB）、启动迅速、零配置快速部署，并提供广告过滤、沉浸式模式、快捷键等丰富功能，极大提升网页应用的使用体验。
repos.summary_en: Pake is a lightweight tool that converts any webpage into a desktop app with one command, built on Rust Tauri for cross-platform support (macOS, Windows, Linux). It offers ultra-small size (~5MB), fast startup, zero-configuration packaging, and features like ad-blocking, immersive mode, and customizable shortcuts for enhanced web app usability.

repos.description: A programming framework for agentic AI
repos.summary_zh: AutoGen 是微软开源的多智能体 AI 编程框架，支持构建自主或人机协作的智能应用。它提供灵活的代理设计、多代理协同机制及与 MCP 等工具的深度集成，适用于复杂任务编排、自动化工作流和交互式 AI 系统开发。
repos.summary_en: AutoGen is an open-source framework for building multi-agent AI applications that can operate autonomously or collaborate with humans. It enables flexible agent design, orchestration, and integration with tools like MCP, supporting complex workflows, automation, and interactive AI systems.

repos.description: The all-in-one AI productivity accelerator. On device and privacy first with no annoying setup or configration.
repos.summary_zh: AnythingLLM 是一款全栈式桌面与 Docker AI 应用，集成 RAG、AI 智能体、无代码智能体构建器及 MCP 兼容性，支持多用户管理与权限控制，提供灵活 LLM 与向量数据库配置，实现文档智能对话与自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: AnythingLLM is a full-stack desktop and Docker-based AI application featuring built-in RAG, AI agents, no-code agent builder, and MCP compatibility. It supports customizable LLMs and vector databases, multi-user management, and seamless document interaction for intelligent chat and automation.

repos.description: Build AI Agents, Visually
repos.summary_zh: Flowise 是一个可视化 AI 智能体构建平台，支持通过拖拽方式快速搭建 LLM 应用流程。它提供图形化界面集成主流大模型、向量数据库和工具节点，支持本地部署与云端服务，适用于开发者和企业快速原型开发与生产部署。
repos.summary_en: Flowise is a visual platform for building AI agents and LLM applications using drag-and-drop workflows. It integrates major LLMs, vector databases, and tools via a no-code interface, supporting both self-hosted and cloud deployment for rapid prototyping and production use.

repos.description: CLI platform to experiment with codegen. Precursor to: https://lovable.dev
repos.summary_zh: gpt-engineer 是一个基于 CLI 的代码生成实验平台，支持通过自然语言描述需求，由 AI 自动生成并执行代码，并可迭代优化。它支持 OpenAI API、本地模型及 Azure 等多种模型，提供项目创建、代码改进和自定义代理基准测试功能，是早期 AI 编程工具的重要探索。
repos.summary_en: gpt-engineer is a CLI platform for experimenting with AI-driven code generation. It allows users to specify software in natural language, watch an AI write and execute code, and iteratively improve it. Supports OpenAI, local models, and Azure, with features for project creation, code improvement, and benchmarking custom agents.

repos.description: Open-source AI gateway. Self-hosted LLM gateway with OpenAI-, Claude- and Gemini-compatible APIs, model routing, access control, usage tracking and cost accounting.
repos.summary_zh: New API 是一个统一的 AI 模型聚合与分发平台，支持将各类大语言模型转换为 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容格式，提供个人与企业级的中心化模型管理网关。
repos.summary_en: New API is a unified AI model hub for aggregation and distribution, supporting cross-conversion of various LLMs into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It serves as a centralized gateway for personal and enterprise model management.

repos.description: 利用AI大模型，一键生成高清短视频 Generate short videos with one click using AI LLM.
repos.summary_zh: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一款基于 AI 大模型的智能短视频生成工具，支持一键生成高清横竖屏视频。用户只需输入主题或关键词，即可自动完成文案生成、素材匹配、语音合成、字幕添加及背景音乐配置，全面覆盖视频创作流程，支持多模型接入与批量处理，适用于内容创作者快速产出高质量短视频。
repos.summary_en: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an AI-powered short video generation tool that leverages large language models to automatically create high-definition videos with one click. Users input a topic or keyword to generate scripts, visuals, voiceovers, subtitles, and background music. It supports multiple AI models, batch processing, and both vertical and horizontal formats, ideal for content creators seeking efficient video production.

repos.description: aider is AI pair programming in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: Aider 是一款终端 AI 结对编程工具，支持与主流大模型（如 Claude、GPT-4、DeepSeek）协作开发，具备代码库映射、Git 集成、100+ 语言支持和 IDE 插件能力，实现自然语言驱动的代码修改与项目管理。
repos.summary_en: Aider is an AI pair programming tool in the terminal that collaborates with LLMs like Claude and GPT-4 to edit code, manage projects, and integrate with Git. It supports codebase mapping, IDE plugins, and works across 100+ programming languages via natural language commands.

repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Claude Skills 是一个精心策划的 Claude AI 技能库，涵盖文档处理、开发工具、数据分析、商业营销等十大领域。通过 Composio 插件，Claude 可连接500+应用执行真实操作（如发邮件、创建工单），实现从文本生成到自动化工作的跨越。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Claude Skills is a curated collection of practical workflows for enhancing Claude AI across platforms. It covers document processing, development tools, data analysis, business automation, and more. With the Composio plugin, Claude can connect to 500+ apps to perform real-world actions like sending emails or creating issues, extending beyond text generation.

repos.description: CowAgent是基于大模型的超级AI助理，能主动思考和任务规划、访问操作系统和外部资源、创造和执行Skills、拥有长期记忆并不断成长。同时支持飞书、钉钉、企业微信应用、微信公众号、网页等接入，可选择OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/ Qwen/GLM/Kimi/LinkAI，能处理文本、语音、图片和文件，可快速搭建个人AI助手和企业数字员工。
repos.summary_zh: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级AI助理，支持主动任务规划、多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件）、长期记忆与技能系统，可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信、微信公众号等多平台，兼容OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek等主流模型，适用于个人AI助手与企业数字员工场景。
repos.summary_en: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, supporting autonomous task planning, multimodal interaction (text/audio/image/files), long-term memory, and a skill system. It integrates with platforms like Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and WeChat Official Accounts, compatible with OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek models, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

repos.description: An AI SKILL that provide design intelligence for building professional UI/UX multiple platforms
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max 是一款 AI 技能，专为多平台构建专业 UI/UX 设计而生。其核心功能是通过 AI 驱动的设计系统生成器，快速分析项目需求并输出适配不同框架的完整设计体系，支持 67 种 UI 风格与 100 条推理规则，显著提升跨平台设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max is an AI skill delivering intelligent design solutions for professional UI/UX across multiple platforms. Its flagship Design System Generator uses AI reasoning to instantly analyze project requirements and generate tailored, framework-agnostic design systems, supporting 67 UI styles and 100 reasoning rules for efficient cross-platform design.

repos.description: Teams-first Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: oh-my-claudecode 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的多智能体协同框架，采用零学习曲线理念。通过团队模式（team）实现 staged pipeline 自动化开发流程，支持 tmux CLI 工作器扩展 Codex/Gemini 能力，提供 deep-interview 需求澄清和 /ccg 混合协作技能，显著提升团队协作效率。
repos.summary_en: oh-my-claudecode is a zero-learning-curve multi-agent orchestration framework for Claude Code. It enables automated team-based development via staged pipelines, supports tmux CLI workers for Codex/Gemini integration, offers deep-interview for requirement clarification, and provides /ccg skill for mixed AI collaboration to boost team productivity.

repos.summary_zh: WeChatMsg 是一个微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，支持将聊天记录导出为多种格式（如 Excel、HTML），并提供可视化分析功能。项目强调个人数据主权，倡导用户自主管理生活痕迹，未来计划结合 AI 技术构建个人记忆数据中心，实现智能相册与年度报告生成。
repos.summary_en: WeChatMsg is a WeChat chat export and analysis tool that supports exporting chats to formats like Excel and HTML with visualization features. It emphasizes personal data ownership, enabling users to manage their digital footprints. The project aims to integrate AI for building personal memory data centers, including smart photo albums and annual report generation.

repos.description: Powerful AI Client
repos.summary_zh: Chatbox 是一款跨平台桌面 AI 客户端，支持 ChatGPT、Claude 等主流大模型，提供多端同步、插件扩展、提示工程优化等功能，适用于开发者、研究人员和AI爱好者的高效生产力工具。
repos.summary_en: Chatbox is a powerful cross-platform desktop AI client supporting ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs. It offers multi-device sync, plugin support, prompt engineering, and advanced customization for developers and AI enthusiasts.

repos.description: 你想蒸馏的下一个员工，何必是同事。蒸馏任何人的思维方式——心智模型、决策启发式、表达DNA。Distill how anyone thinks.
repos.summary_zh: 女娲.skill 是一个 AI 技能蒸馏工具，通过分析公开资料提取顶尖人物的认知框架、决策启发式和表达模式，让用户直接调用乔布斯、马斯克等名人的思维方式解决实际问题。核心功能包括五层心智模型提取（表达DNA、认知框架、决策启发式、反模式、诚实边界），支持一键安装并已在 Claude Code 中验证可用性。
repos.summary_en: Nuwa.skill is an AI agent that distills the cognitive frameworks, decision heuristics, and communication patterns of top-tier individuals like Jobs, Musk, and Zhang Xuefeng from public data. It enables users to invoke these distilled mental models directly in Claude Code for problem-solving. It supports uploading PDF, TXT, DOCX, MD files and integrates multiple embedding models for semantic retrieval, enabling private, offline document understanding and question answering.

repos.description: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension that allows you to specify, plan, and implement software features.

repos.summary_en: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension enabling Context-Driven Development by managing the full lifecycle of software features—from context setup, spec/plan generation, to safe implementation. It ensures high-quality, team-aligned development with intelligent planning and git-aware reverts.

repos.summary_zh: ReadmeAI 是一款基于 AI 的 README 文件自动生成工具，支持通过代码仓库 URL 或本地路径一键生成结构化、详细的文档。支持 OpenAI、Ollama、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种 LLM 模型，具备智能文件过滤、离线模式运行、高度可定制化模板与样式等功能，旨在提升开发者文档编写效率。
repos.summary_en: ReadmeAI is an AI-powered tool that automatically generates high-quality README files from code repositories. It supports multiple LLM backends (OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic, Gemini), offers customizable templates, intelligent file filtering via .readmeaiignore, and works offline. Designed to boost developer productivity and ensure consistent documentation across projects.

It is fully compatible with ChatGPT's API interface, supports zero-configuration deployment and multi-token load balancing, intended only for personal testing, commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: One Hub All LLMs For You | 为个人打造的 LLM API 聚合网关
repos.summary_zh: Octopus 是一款为个人用户设计的 LLM API 聚合服务，支持多通道接入、智能负载均衡与协议转换。具备统一密钥管理、自动模型同步、价格追踪及多数据库支持（SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL），提供美观的 Web 管理面板和全面的请求分析功能，实现高效稳定的 AI 接口统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Octopus is a personal LLM API aggregation service that unifies multiple provider channels with intelligent load balancing and protocol conversion. It supports multi-key management, automatic model/pricing sync, comprehensive analytics, and elegant UI, with multi-database support (SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL) for stable and efficient AI interface management.

Comprehensive AI search optimization for any website — citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority, schema markup, platform-specific optimization, and PDF reports.  If you want learn how to sell this to real businesses, check out the skool community
repos.summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的 GEO-first SEO 技能，提供全面的 AI 搜索引擎优化服务，包括内容可引用性评分、AI 爬虫分析、品牌权威性评估、结构化数据生成及跨平台优化，支持 PDF 报告输出，助力企业抢占 AI 流量入口。
repos.summary_en: A GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code that delivers comprehensive AI search optimization, including citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority assessment, schema markup generation, and platform-specific tuning, with professional PDF reporting capabilities to capture high-converting AI-driven traffic.

repos.description: Minimal plugin that lets Claude Code call you on the phone.
repos.summary_zh: CallMe 是一个极简的 Claude Code 插件，允许通过电话在任务完成、卡住或需要决策时呼叫用户。支持多轮语音对话，兼容智能手机、智能手表等设备，并可通过 ngrok 实现远程 webhook 连接。
repos.summary_en: CallMe is a minimal plugin for Claude Code that enables phone calls to alert users when tasks are done, stuck, or require decisions. It supports multi-turn voice conversations via OpenAI's TTS/STT, works across smartphones and smartwatches, and uses ngrok for secure webhook tunneling.

repos.description: Real-time multi-AI collaboration: Claude, Codex & Gemini with persistent context, minimal token overhead
repos.summary_zh: CCB v6 是一款原生多智能体终端运行时，支持 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等 AI 模型的并行协作。通过持久化上下文和最小化 token 开销，实现可见的并发执行、原生通信及项目级作用域管理，适用于复杂开发场景下的多角色协同编程。
repos.summary_en: CCB v6 is a native multi-agent runtime for terminal split panes, enabling real-time collaboration across Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other AI models. It provides persistent context, minimal token overhead, visible concurrency, and project-scoped runtime with built-in agent communication and delegation.

repos.description: Pipelines: Versatile, UI-Agnostic OpenAI-Compatible Plugin Framework
repos.summary_zh: Pipelines 是 Open WebUI 推出的开源插件框架，支持在任意兼容 OpenAI API 的 UI 客户端中运行自定义 Python 工作流。它允许开发者通过轻量代码扩展功能，如实现 RAG、消息监控、翻译过滤等复杂逻辑，适用于需要高性能计算或定制化 AI 流程的场景。
repos.summary_en: Pipelines is an open-source plugin framework by Open WebUI that enables modular, customizable workflows for any UI client supporting OpenAI API specs. It allows developers to extend functionality with custom Python logic—such as RAG, message monitoring, or translation filters—ideal for offloading heavy computations from main instances.

repos.description: Real-time multi-AI collaboration: Claude, Codex & Gemini with persistent context, minimal token overhead
repos.summary_zh: Claude Code Bridge (ccb) 是一个多AI模型协作工具，支持 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等模型在分屏终端中实时协同工作。核心优势包括持久化上下文记忆、低token开销的轻量异步通信机制，以及原生集成 WezTerm/tmux 的工作流。所有交互可视化，每个模型均可控，避免单一模型偏差与认知盲区。
repos.summary_en: Claude Code Bridge (ccb) enables real-time multi-AI collaboration via a split-pane terminal, supporting models like Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context per AI instance, minimal token usage through lightweight prompts, and seamless integration with WezTerm or tmux. Every interaction is visible and controllable, eliminating single-model bias and context limits.

repos.description: Desktop app to manage AI coding agent skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex, and 20+ platforms from one place.
repos.summary_zh: skills-manage 是一款基于 Tauri 的桌面应用，统一管理 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 20+ AI 编程工具的技能库。支持中央技能库管理、跨平台安装卸载、GitHub 仓库导入、Obsidian 项目发现及智能搜索等功能，提供 Markdown 预览和 AI 解释生成能力。
repos.summary_en: skills-manage is a Tauri-based desktop app for centralized management of AI coding agent skills across 20+ platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It features a unified skill library, cross-platform symlink installation, GitHub repository import, project-level discovery (including Obsidian vaults), and bilingual UI with Catppuccin themes.

repos.description: 🎒 钉钉 & 🤖 GPT-3.5 让你的工作效率直接起飞 🚀 私聊群聊方式、单聊串聊模式、角色扮演、图片创作 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go语言开发的钉钉ChatGPT机器人，集成GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini模型，支持私聊、群聊、角色扮演、图片生成等功能，提供Docker部署和Azure-OpenAI支持，显著提升办公沟通效率。
repos.summary_en: A Go-based ChatGPT bot integrated with DingTalk, supporting GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini models, featuring private/group chat, role-playing, image generation, and Azure-OpenAI compatibility via Docker deployment for enhanced workplace productivity.

repos.description: JSON-driven multi-agent  cadence-team development framework with   intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex),   context-first architecture, and automated workflow   execution
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Code-Workflow 是一个基于 JSON 驱动的 Multi-Agent AI 开发框架，支持智能 CLI 编排（集成 Gemini/Qwen/Codex）、上下文优先架构和自动化工作流执行。通过技能化工作流系统实现团队级协作开发，提供终端仪表盘监控、队列调度及可视化编辑器，适用于复杂 AI 项目协同场景。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Code-Workflow is a JSON-driven multi-agent development framework featuring intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex), context-first architecture, and automated workflow execution. It enables team-based AI development through skill-based workflows, terminal dashboard monitoring, queue scheduling, and visual workflow editing for complex collaborative projects.

repos.summary_en: This project provides unofficial bilingual Chinese-English subtitles for Andrew Ng and OpenAI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' course, covering 9 practical chapters on prompt writing, including text classification, summarization, translation, and chatbot development, with interactive notebooks and Bilibili videos to help developers master this high-leverage AI skill.

repos.summary_en: This project systematically collects and categorizes high-quality prompts from the GPT Store, covering diverse domains such as writing, development, marketing, and education. It combines manually curated content with automated collection to provide a comprehensive prompt library, significantly enhancing AI application development efficiency and creative implementation capabilities.

repos.summary_en: Chat2API is a cross-platform unified management tool for AI services, enabling zero-cost access to leading models like DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen, and Z.ai via official web UIs. It provides OpenAI-compatible APIs, seamless integration with tools such as openlcaw, Cline, and Roo-Code, advanced features like context management, function calling, model mapping, and real-time monitoring dashboard with proxy support.

repos.description: [GenAI Application Development Framework]  🚀 Build GenAI application quick and easy 💬 Easy to interact with GenAI agent in code using structure data and chained-calls syntax 🧩 Use Event-Driven Flow *TriggerFlow* to manage complex GenAI working logic 🔀 Switch to any model without rewrite application code
repos.summary_zh: Agently 4 是一个生产级 GenAI 应用开发框架，支持结构化数据交互、链式调用语法和事件驱动流（TriggerFlow）编排复杂工作逻辑。它提供契约优先的输出控制、多模型无缝切换能力，并集成会话管理、工具调用与 FastAPI，显著提升 AI 应用的开发效率与稳定性。
repos.summary_en: Agently 4 is a production-grade GenAI application development framework enabling structured data interaction, chained-calls syntax, and event-driven flow orchestration via TriggerFlow. It offers contract-first output control, seamless model switching, session management, tool integration, and FastAPI support to accelerate reliable AI app development.

repos.description: Deploy your private Gemini application for free with one click, supporting Gemini 1.5, Gemini 2.0 models.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Next Chat 是一个开源的 Gemini AI 聊天框架，支持一键免费部署私有应用，兼容 Gemini 1.5/2.0 系列模型。基于 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 构建，提供 Web、桌面多端支持，具备函数调用扩展能力，适用于企业级私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Next Chat is an open-source, extensible chatbot framework for Gemini AI models (1.5/2.0). Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, it enables one-click free deployment of private web applications across Web, MacOS, Windows, and Linux platforms with function calling support.

repos.description: 🐒一些修改自网络的油猴脚本 Some Tampermonkey scripts modified from the internet
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列基于油猴脚本（Tampermonkey）的自动化工具，多数脚本改编自网络资源，涵盖网页功能增强、界面优化及实用小工具。所有脚本均托管于GreasyFork平台，支持多语言版本，具备高安装量和良好用户评价，适用于提升日常浏览与操作效率。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts a collection of Tampermonkey user scripts, mostly modified from online sources, designed to enhance web functionality, optimize interfaces, and provide utility tools. Hosted on GreasyFork with multi-language support, these scripts boast high installation counts and positive user ratings, ideal for improving browsing efficiency and user experience.

repos.description: 这是一个基于Claude Skill的**AI人像Prompt生成系统**，能够从特征库中智能组合生成高质量的人像描述Prompt，并具备自动学习和库扩展能力。 核心能力: Prompt生成、特征提取、自动学习、智能审核、版本控制
repos.summary_zh: 基于Claude Skills的AI人像Prompt生成系统，集成12个专业领域Skills与1246+元素库，支持Portrait/Cross-Domain/Design三种智能生成模式。具备语义理解、跨域组合、变量采样等核心能力，提供自动学习、智能审核和版本控制功能，实现从特征提取到高质量提示词生成的全流程自动化。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered prompt generation system based on Claude Skills, integrating 12 domain-specific skills with a 1,246+ element library. Supports three intelligent modes: Portrait, Cross-Domain, and Design. Features semantic understanding, cross-domain composition, variable sampling, automatic learning, intelligent review, and version control for end-to-end automated prompt generation.

repos.description: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，解决 AI 写作中的「遗忘」和「幻觉」问题，支持 200 万字量级 连载创作。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文创作辅助系统，通过双 Agent 架构和六维审查机制解决 AI 写作中的遗忘与幻觉问题，支持 200 万字级连载创作，集成 RAG 检索、创意约束系统和追读力机制，确保叙事连贯性与读者粘性。
repos.summary_en: A long-form webnovel writing assistant built on Claude Code, utilizing dual-agent architecture and six-dimensional review mechanisms to address AI writing issues like forgetting and hallucination, supporting serialized creation up to 2 million words with RAG retrieval, creative constraint systems, and reader engagement mechanics.

repos.description: 🚀 一键部署个人的 ChatGPT 镜像站
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT Mirror 是一个个人 ChatGPT 镜像站，支持多账号共享管理，提供与官网一致的完整功能体验。通过录入 ChatGPT Token 实现团队协作访问，内置 API 接口（/v1/chat/completions）兼容主流客户端，无需翻墙即可使用。支持 Docker 一键部署，含管理后台和临时聊天模式，现已停止维护并推荐迁移至 Grok Mirror。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT Mirror is a personal ChatGPT mirror site enabling multi-account sharing and management for team collaboration. It delivers full-featured access identical to the official site, with built-in API (/v1/chat/completions) compatible with clients like ChatGPT-Next-Web. No VPN required; supports Docker one-click deployment, admin panel, and ephemeral chat modes. Discontinued; users advised to migrate to Grok Mirror.

repos.description: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
repos.summary_zh: Poco 是一款基于 Claude Code 的智能体平台，提供比 OpenClaw 更美观易用的替代方案。核心特性包括安全沙箱环境、多模态文件支持、原生 Claude Code 交互体验（计划模式/提问模式）、内置浏览器与 GitHub 集成、MCP/Skills 扩展能力，以及钉钉/飞书/Telegram 消息集成。采用 Next.js + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker 一键部署和移动端访问。
repos.summary_en: Poco is a safer and more user-friendly alternative to OpenClaw, powered by a Claude Code-based agent. It features a secure sandboxed runtime, native Claude Code experience (Plan Mode, AskQuestion), built-in browser, GitHub integration, MCP/Skills extensibility, IM integrations (DingTalk/Feishu/Telegram), and multilingual support. Built with Next.js + FastAPI, deployable via Docker with mobile access.

repos.description: Desktop Agent for Any Task

repos.summary_en: WorkAny is a desktop AI agent that executes tasks via natural language, featuring real-time code generation, sandboxed execution, and workspace management. Built on Claude Agent SDK with MCP support and multi-provider LLM integration, it enables automated file organization, document/web/table/slide generation, and software development workflows.

repos.summary_zh: Gemini Business2API 将 Gemini Business 转换为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡、自动化注册登录、多模态文件解析（100+格式）、图像/视频生成及流式输出。提供 Docker 部署、管理面板和 PostgreSQL/SQLite 存储，适用于个人技术研究与非商业场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Business2API converts Gemini Business into an OpenAI-compatible API with multi-account load balancing, automated account management, multimodal file parsing (100+ formats), image/video generation, and streaming responses. repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework designed for the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It offers multi-platform bot integration (Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom), native Function Calling, 25 built-in tools, memory system, cron jobs, and a skill-based architecture. With ~16K lines of clean code, it's ideal for learning agent principles and rapid development of enterprise-grade AI assistants.

repos.description: claude-skill:用户需求洞察与产品机会分析技能。适用于新产品开发、营销策划、品类切入前的市场分析。当你需要快速理解目标用户、挖掘情绪动机、将洞察转化为可落地的产品机会时使用此技能。基于三段式提示词框架，帮助你在10分钟内完成传统方法需要数周才能完成的用户洞察分析。这不是泛泛而谈的空话，而是能看到具体画面的深度洞察，可直接用于产品设计和营销文案。
repos.summary_zh: Market Insight Skill 是基于 Claude Code 的用户需求洞察与产品机会分析技能，采用三段式框架（用户画像、情绪洞察、产品机会）。能在10分钟内完成传统数周的用户研究，输出具画面感的深度洞察，直接用于产品设计与营销文案，适用于餐饮、SaaS、电商等多个行业的新品开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Market Insight Skill is a user demand insight and product opportunity analysis skill for Claude Code, utilizing a three-stage framework (user profiling, emotional insights, product opportunities). It enables completing traditional weeks-long user research in just 10 minutes, delivering concrete visual insights directly applicable to product design and marketing copy across industries like food, SaaS, and e-commerce.

repos.description: 基于 [Karpathy llm-wiki]方法论，利用 AI 持续构建和维护你的个人知识库。支持从多种素材源（网页、推特、公众号、小红书、知乎、YouTube、PDF、本地文件）自动整理为结构化的 wiki，并通过 Quartz 发布为静态wiki知识库网站。 并通过 claude_agent_sdk 调用 claude agent 使用 llm-wiki ,提供api接口对外访问服务 。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Karpathy llm-wiki 方法论构建的个人 AI 知识库系统，支持从网页、社交媒体、PDF 等多元素材源自动提取并结构化生成 wiki 内容，通过 Quartz 发布为静态网站，并利用 Claude Agent SDK 提供 API 服务，实现端到端的智能知识管理与检索增强生成（RAG）。
repos.summary_en: A personal AI knowledge base system based on Karpathy's llm-wiki methodology, enabling automated ingestion and structuring of content from diverse sources (web, social media, PDFs) into a wiki format. It publishes knowledge via Quartz as a static site and exposes capabilities through the Claude Agent SDK with RESTful APIs for agentic RAG applications.

repos.description: Deployed on Cloudflare Worker, using the free Flux model and optimizing prompts with LLM. It can be called from any application compatible with the OpenAI API. 部署于Cloudflare Worker，免费使用Flux模型，并通过LLM进行提示词优化，支持在任何兼容OpenAI API的应用中调用。
repos.summary_zh: Flux-API-Worker 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Worker 上的 AI 图像生成服务，免费使用 Flux 模型并通过 LLM 优化提示词，提供兼容 OpenAI API 的接口，支持自定义提示、多尺寸输出、KV 缓存及 CORS，适用于各类应用集成。
repos.summary_en: Flux-API-Worker is an AI image generation service deployed on Cloudflare Workers, utilizing the free Flux model and LLM-powered prompt optimization. It offers an OpenAI-compatible API for seamless integration into any application, supporting custom prompts, multiple aspect ratios, KV storage, and streaming responses.

repos.description: AI-powered JSON translation tool with agentic reflection using OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs
repos.summary_zh: Jta 是一款基于 AI 的智能 JSON 翻译工具，采用代理式反思机制实现自我优化翻译。通过 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Gemini 三大 AI 平台，支持多语言国际化文件翻译，具备术语管理、增量翻译和格式保护等生产级功能，确保翻译准确性和一致性。
repos.summary_en: Jta is an AI-powered JSON translation tool featuring an agentic reflection mechanism for self-optimizing translations. Using OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini APIs, it supports multi-language i18n files with terminology management, incremental translation, and format protection for production-grade accuracy and consistency.

repos.description: OpenAI中转
repos.summary_zh: 本项目将 Cursor 编辑器的 AI 能力转换为 OpenAI API 兼容接口，支持通过 Bearer Token 认证调用聊天补全功能。用户只需提供 WorkosCursorSessionToken 即可在其他应用中复用 Cursor 的 AI 服务，适用于集成开发、自动化脚本等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project converts Cursor editor's AI capabilities into an OpenAI-compatible API interface, enabling reuse of Cursor's AI functionality in other applications. It supports chat completion via Bearer Token authentication using WorkosCursorSessionToken, ideal for integration and automation use cases.

repos.description: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
repos.summary_zh: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
repos.summary_en: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

repos.description: A cross-platform skills manager for AI IDEs. Search marketplace, download locally, and install to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and more with one click.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款跨平台 AI IDE 技能管理工具，支持聚合搜索 Claude、Cursor、Windsurf 等10+主流AI开发环境的技能插件，一键下载至本地统一仓库并通过安全符号链接快速安装，提供版本控制、批量部署和自定义IDE支持，显著提升AI编程助手的功能扩展效率。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a cross-platform AI IDE skills management tool that aggregates search across major marketplaces (Claude Plugins, SkillsLLM, etc.), downloads skills to a unified local repository, and enables one-click installation into 10+ supported AI IDEs via secure symlinks. It features version control, bulk deployment, and custom IDE support for enhanced AI programming assistant capabilities.

repos.description: 让 Grok Chat 物尽其用
repos.summary_zh: grok-proxy 是一个基于 Go 的代理服务，将 Grok Chat 网页接口转换为 OpenAI API 兼容格式，支持流式/非流式响应、多模态图片输入、联网搜索及思考模式。用户通过 SSO Cookie 认证调用，支持 SOCKS5 代理池轮询，提供 Docker 快速部署和自定义配置能力。
repos.summary_en: grok-proxy is a Go-based proxy service that converts Grok Chat's web interface into an OpenAI API-compatible format. It supports streaming/non-streaming responses, multimodal image input, web search, and reasoning mode. Authentication via SSO cookie, with optional SOCKS5 proxy pool rotation. Offers Docker deployment, model selection, and custom configuration via environment variables.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

repos.description: My personal collection of open-source Claude Code skills
repos.summary_zh: PhasedddSkill 是个人开源 Claude Code 技能集合，包含多智能体辩论系统（council）及其中文适配版，以及模仿 MediaStorm 创始人 Tim 独特文风的写作技能。核心亮点在于通过角色化 AI 代理实现跨领域深度讨论与创意生成，支持中英双语场景。
repos.summary_en: PhasedddSkill is a personal open-source collection of Claude Code skills, featuring a multi-agent debate system (council) with distinct personas for complex discussions, its Chinese adaptation council-zh, and a writing skill emulating Tim's (founder of MediaStorm) unique blend of tech rationality and humanistic poetry. Key strengths include role-based AI collaboration and stylized content generation.

repos.description: singleFile + gh pages + deepseek api + notion db + tg bot = web clipper and notify
repos.summary_zh: Web Clipper Backend 是一个网页剪藏服务，支持将网页通过 SingleFile 插件保存至 GitHub Pages，利用 DeepSeek API 自动生成摘要与标签，并同步至 Notion 数据库，同时通过 Telegram Bot 推送通知，实现全自动化内容归档与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: Web Clipper Backend is an automated web clipping service that saves web pages via SingleFile to GitHub Pages, uses DeepSeek API for AI-generated summaries and tags, syncs data to Notion database, and sends notifications via Telegram Bot, enabling seamless content archiving and knowledge management.

repos.description: 简易版api集合器
repos.summary_zh: UniAPI 是一个兼容 OpenAI 协议的 API 转发器，支持多密钥管理与模型择优机制，自动选择高成功率、低延迟的服务商。集成断路器机制防止异常服务雪崩，优化流式响应展示效果，适用于 Azure OpenAI、Claude 等兼容服务，提供安全的 Bearer Token 认证与 Vercel 一键部署。
repos.summary_en: UniAPI is an OpenAI-compatible API proxy that manages multiple API keys and selects optimal providers based on 72-hour success rate and latency. It includes a circuit breaker to prevent cascading failures and optimizes streaming responses for better UX, supporting Azure OpenAI, Claude, and other compatible services with secure Bearer Token auth and Vercel deployment.

repos.description: 原版乔木 UI 学习的 DeepSeek Harness 迁移版：13561 设计参考、106 交互标本、审美测验与 Markdown 学习笔记

repos.description: 让 Claude Code 更易用，支持多配置切换。
repos.summary_zh: auo 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的 CLI 工具，通过多配置切换和环境变量管理提升使用体验。支持自动配置升级与向后兼容，适用于多账号/代理场景下的无缝切换，显著简化 Anthropic API 的复杂配置流程。
repos.summary_en: auo is a CLI tool designed to enhance Claude Code usability by enabling easy multi-configuration switching and environment variable management. It supports automatic config upgrades with full backward compatibility, ideal for seamless transitions between multiple accounts or proxy setups, streamlining Anthropic API configuration.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Grok AI 代理服务，提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 和可视化 Web 管理界面，支持文本对话、多规格图片生成及视频创作，具备 Token 自动轮换、API Key 速率限制与一键部署能力。
repos.summary_en: A Cloudflare Workers-based proxy for Grok AI, offering OpenAI-compatible APIs and a web admin interface. Supports text chat, image/video generation with customizable ratios, token auto-rotation, rate limiting, and one-click deployment.

repos.description: 🍟 This project is configured with an advanced AI collaboration workflow based on `CLAUDE.md`. It uses **Claude** as the core orchestrator, dispatches **Auggie (ACE)** for efficient context retrieval, and leverages **Codex** and **Gemini** for logical analysis, prototype generation, and code auditing—achieving a "**1+1+1>3**" collaborative effect.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目构建了一套基于CLAUDE.md的高级AI协作工作流，以Claude为核心编排器，调度Auggie进行上下文检索，并协同Codex与Gemini实现逻辑分析、原型生成和代码审计，形成1+1+1>3的多模型协同效应，适用于企业级智能开发场景。
repos.summary_en: This project implements an advanced AI collaboration workflow based on CLAUDE.md, with Claude as the orchestrator, Auggie for context retrieval, and Codex/Gemini for logic analysis, prototyping, and code auditing—achieving synergistic '1+1+1>3' multi-model collaboration for enterprise-grade development.

repos.description: 小米 MiMo 模型 OpenAI 兼容 API Python版
repos.summary_zh: 小米 MiMo AI 模型 OpenAI 兼容 API Python 实现，支持深度思考、流式响应和多账号负载均衡。基于 FastAPI 构建，提供 Web 管理界面与自动 API 文档，轻松将小米 Mimo 接入标准 OpenAI 接口。
repos.summary_en: MiMo2API Python implementation provides OpenAI-compatible API for Xiaomi's MiMo AI model, supporting reasoning effort, streaming responses, and multi-account load balancing. Built with FastAPI, it includes a web admin interface and auto-generated documentation.

repos.summary_zh: AnyRouter OpenCode Bridge 是一个专为 OpenCode 和 CherryStudio 设计的本地代理工具，通过 FastAPI + HTTP/2 中间层解决 AnyRouter API 的 WAF 拦截与 TLS 指纹检测问题，支持 Header 伪装、工具注入、流式透传及配置热重载，实现 Claude Code 客户端的无缝接入。
repos.summary_en: AnyRouter OpenCode Bridge is a local proxy tool designed for OpenCode and CherryStudio, resolving WAF blocking and TLS fingerprint issues when accessing AnyRouter API via an HTTP/2-enabled FastAPI middleware. It supports header spoofing, tool injection, SSE streaming, and hot-reload configuration for seamless integration with Claude Code clients.

repos.description: 🧠 Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code as an AI writing companion — smart context, undo, diff preview, multi-thread chat.
repos.summary_zh: Niki AI 是一款专为 Obsidian 设计的 AI 增强插件，通过在侧边栏集成 Claude Code 实现智能写作辅助。核心功能包括原生对话界面、自动上下文引用、修改撤销和多话题管理，支持@文件引用和代码差异预览，显著提升 Markdown 笔记的编辑效率与交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Niki AI is an AI-enhanced plugin for Obsidian that integrates Claude Code into the sidebar for intelligent writing assistance. Key features include native chat UI, automatic context inclusion, undo functionality, and multi-topic management, with support for @file references and code diff previews to boost Markdown note editing efficiency.

repos.description: 基于 claude code sdk 的 agent api，兼容Skills + Sub Agents
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Claude Code SDK 的轻量级本地代理，提供 HTTP POST + SSE 流式接口，兼容 Skills 与 Sub Agents。支持会话持久化、历史查询及 Docker 部署，适用于 Worker/DO 统一调用 Anthropic 兼容 API。
repos.summary_en: Lightweight local proxy for Claude Agent SDK using TypeScript + Bun, offering HTTP POST + SSE streaming interface. Compatible with Skills and Sub Agents, supports session persistence, history retrieval, and Docker deployment for unified access to Anthropic-compatible APIs.

repos.summary_zh: Arcee Bridge 是一个自动化工具，通过 YYDS Mail 自动创建邮箱并完成 Arcee AI 账号注册，获取 access_token 后将其封装为 OpenAI 兼容的 API 网关。支持完整注册流程（发邮件、验证、登录）并暴露 /v1/chat/completions 等标准接口，适用于快速接入 OpenAI 风格客户端或构建代理层实验环境。
repos.summary_en: Arcee Bridge is an automation tool that auto-registers Arcee accounts via YYDS Mail, retrieves access tokens, and exposes them as an OpenAI-compatible API gateway. It handles the full signup flow (email verification, login) and provides standard endpoints like /v1/chat/completions for easy integration with OpenAI-style clients or proxy layers.

repos.description: 怎样利用claude skills 简单的实现一个适合自己的“微舆”？适合自己的简单“微舆” 。社媒+深度调研 2个skills 合体 的 agent智能体：AI启动了 Web Search 和 via TikHub （社交媒体）进行深度调研 ，2个skills都正常调用了。  2个skills 混合在一起合体使用
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库构建了一个基于 Claude Code 智能体的社交媒体深度研究系统，结合 Web Search 与 TikHub API 实现多平台数据采集。通过并行子智能体架构，支持对 TikTok、微博、知乎等14+平台进行跨文化影响力分析，自动生成带引用的结构化研究报告，适用于品牌监测、舆情分析及人物影响力评估。
repos.summary_en: This repository implements a social media research system using Claude Code agents integrated with TikHub API for multi-platform data collection. It employs parallel sub-agents to analyze 14+ platforms like TikTok and Weibo, generating structured reports with citations for cross-cultural influence studies, brand monitoring, and public figure impact assessments.

repos.description: 油猴 chatgpt Prompt 脚本插件，在chatgpt聊天框导入Prompt 对话框
repos.summary_zh: 该油猴脚本为 ChatGPT 网页端提供中文 Prompt 训练对话框插件，支持一键导入预设角色提示词，提升交互效率。基于 GreasyFork 部署，集成 Docusaurus 搜索功能并优化 PC 端中文输入延迟问题。强调使用英文提示词以获得更稳定输出，建议添加 'respond in Chinese' 控制回复语言。
repos.summary_en: A Tampermonkey script that adds a Chinese Prompt training dialog to ChatGPT's web interface, enabling one-click import of role-based prompts for enhanced productivity. Hosted on GreasyFork with Docusaurus-powered search, it addresses PC-side input lag via debounce. Recommends English prompts for reliability and supports language control via 'respond in Chinese'.

repos.description: DSH 插件：统计所有经过 DeepSeek Harness 的模型调用——Token 用量、成本核算（含峰谷计价）、供应商余额与配额，并按模型/供应商/项目/来源/账号/日期拆分。A token usage, cost and provider-balance plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

repos.description: 在 tmux 中管理交互式 Claude Code agent，并在 kitty 中协调不同 code agent 的可见协作与接力
repos.summary_zh: CCM Orchestra 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的控制平面，通过 tmux 实现持久化交互式代理会话管理，并利用 kitty 提供可视化协作与消息中继功能。该系统采用分层架构：tmux 层负责会话生命周期管理与工作目录隔离，kitty 层支持多代理可见协作与接力通信，形成可观测、可复用的 AI 编程协作模型。
repos.summary_en: CCM Orchestra is a control plane for managing persistent, interactive Claude Code agents in tmux while enabling visible collaboration between code agents through kitty. It features a two-layer architecture: the tmux layer maintains reusable agent sessions with worktree isolation, while the kitty layer provides human-observable coordination and message relay capabilities, forming a paired operating model for parallel AI-assisted development workflows.

repos.description: A CLI/TUI tool to manage and switch tokens & base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex.
repos.summary_zh: agtok 是一个 CLI/TUI 工具，用于集中管理和切换 Claude、Gemini 和 Codex 等 AI 代理的令牌与基础 URL。支持交互式终端界面、预设分组、原子化写入与备份，适用于多环境 AI 工具配置管理。
repos.summary_en: agtok is a CLI/TUI tool for centrally managing and switching tokens and base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex. It supports interactive TUI, preset grouping, atomic writes with backups, and seamless configuration switching across environments.

repos.description: oag is a lightweight CLI for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command install and   update of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for   consistent setup and faster team collaboration.
repos.summary_zh: oag 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，用于管理基于 Git 的 AI 资产注册中心，支持一键安装、更新代理、技能及 MCP 配置到 Claude、Codex 和 OpenCode 等本地环境，提升团队协作效率与配置一致性。
repos.summary_en: oag is a lightweight CLI tool for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command installation and updates of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for consistent setup and faster team collaboration.

repos.description: Gemini Nexus 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini 能力的 Chrome 扩展程序。它不仅仅是一个侧边栏插件，而是通过注入式的悬浮工具栏、强大的图像 AI 处理以及前沿的浏览器控制协议 (MCP)，将 AI 的触角伸向网页浏览的每一个交互细节。
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Nova 是一款深度集成 Google Gemini AI 的 Chrome 扩展程序，通过悬浮工具栏、图像 AI 处理及浏览器控制协议 (MCP) 实现网页交互智能化。支持多驱动方案（Web Client/官方 API/OpenAI兼容），提供侧边栏对话、划词翻译总结、Mermaid 图表渲染、OCR 截图翻译及外部 MCP 工具集成等核心功能，赋予浏览器原生 AI 能力。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Nova is a Chrome extension deeply integrated with Google Gemini AI, enabling intelligent web interaction via floating toolbars, image AI processing, and Browser Control Protocol (MCP). It supports multiple backends (Web Client/Official API/OpenAI-compatible), offering features like sidebar chat, text translation/summary, Mermaid chart rendering, OCR screenshot translation, and external MCP tool integration for enhanced agentic capabilities.
